description: v0.1.82 (C373, P1; CORE v0.1.82): the bound payload digest of a workflow grant request. Normalise (targets sorted by product; ops sorted and unique; crud unique in the order create, read, update, delete; reason omitted when absent or empty), build {ins, wfl, title, targets, reason?}, serialize with JCS (RFC 8785), digest = 'sha256:' + lower-case hex SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes. Core, the GUI and conformance use these rows.
